name: buddy
description: A little minion that walks right to left above the prompt, stops to say bello, dance, nap or chase a butterfly, then carries on.

skin.title: Skin
skin.description: minion has goggle eyes and says bello and banana; classic is the plain buddy

rows.title: Height
rows.description: compact takes one row above the prompt; tall takes two so hearts and hops float above the buddy

showWhileWorking.title: Show while Claude works
showWhileWorking.description: Turn off to give the row back while a turn is running
